events.title: QR Fit Trail - Instructor Led Sessions
events.description: Looking for an exciting workout experience? Follow a scenic trail and scan QR codes at each station to access video instructions for your next exercise. This program goes beyond walking by incorporating resistance and flexibility exercises to build strength, improve mobility, and reduce the risk of injury. Let’s get moving together and create a balanced and effective fitness routine!

events.title: Disco Party
events.description:
Disco is not dead! Join us and grove to the dazzling sounds of 70s Disco. Lunch will be served and Disco Band “We Are Family” will jam. So, put on your bell bottoms, hip huggers, platform shoes and prepare to get down on it. Can you dig it? Don’t miss the fun! Seats are limited. Doors open at 10:30 am.


WE ARE FAMILY
Since 1990, WE ARE FAMILY have been performing across the United States as one of the most beloved and authentic Motown and variety dance bands, with a repertoire of more than 400 songs spanning multiple styles. Their spot‑on vocals, tight musicianship, and standout showmanship make every performance unforgettable. Known for getting audiences on their feet, We Are Family read the crowd with ease, take requests, and create an interactive, high‑energy experience.

events.title: Open Carving Days
events.description:
Come see artist Carving Colin bring two new wood sculptures to life during a live carving experience at Clearwater Nature Center. This event is supported in part by the Maryland State Arts Council.

Location: Clearwater Nature Center, 11401 Thrift Rd, Clinton, MD 20735.

Weekly Schedule:
Week 1: October 5-9, 11 am-5 pm
Week 2: October 12-16, 11 am-5 pm
Week 3: October 19-22, 11 am-5 pm
Week 4: October 26-28, 11 am-5 pm

events.title: Spooktacular Bingo
events.description: Get ready for an afternoon of Halloween-themed bingo where we will play several games. Wear your favorite Halloween colors or a costume. Play for prizes and bragging rights. Sweet treats will be provided. Sign up in the FREE Book at the front desk of John E. Howard Senior Activity Center. Space is limited.

events.title: Halloweenie Roast Campfire
events.description: Enjoy Halloween tales and roasted marshmallows around a community campfire while making family memories and new friendships in the beautiful outdoors. Marshmallows and roasting sticks will be provided, and children must attend with a registered parent or adult; feel free to bring hot dogs, other food, and non-alcoholic drinks.

events.title: Spooky Movie and Pumpkin Paint
events.description: Come dressed for the season and decorate your pumpkin while watching a family-friendly Halloween movie. All supplies included in registration fee.

events.title: A Magical Night of Wizardry
events.description:
Dear Honored Guest,

We are delighted to inform you that you have been invited to an evening of magic, mystery, and Halloween fun!
Join us for enchanted beverages, magical snacks, spellbinding crafts, and a screening of a favorite wizard-inspired film. Brave guests are also invited to journey through the Enchanted Watkins Forest, if you dare.
We look forward to welcoming you for a night of wonder and adventure!

For any questions or concerns please email Tristan.Colding@pgparks.com.

Sincerely,
Tristan Colding
Professor of Magical Events

events.title: Fitness in the Parks - Full Body Sculpt: Strength & Conditioning
events.description: Join us for an energetic, outdoor fitness class that is designed to engage and strengthen every major muscle group. This workout program integrates body weight exercises, cardiovascular endurance, and functional movements which help with the development of lean muscle and improved mobility, with the accountability and support of group training.

events.title: Watkins Park Farmers Market
events.description:
Come support new growers, explore the fields, and take home something delicious at the Urban Farm Incubator at Watkins Regional Park.

Every Saturday, 10 am-2 pm, from late May to mid-November, you can shop fresh vegetables, fruit, herbs, and flowers grown on-site by ten emerging farm businesses. Expect nutrient‑dense, culturally relevant, all‑natural produce!

DIRECTIONS: Once inside Watkins Regional Park, follow signs for the Urban Farm Incubator and park inside the black deer fence.

The Urban Farm Incubator hosts ten beginner farm businesses growing vegetables, fruit, herbs, and flowers. The Urban Farm Incubator at Watkins Regional Park is a collaboration among ECO City Farms, the Prince George’s Soil Conservation District (PGSCD), Prince George’s Food Equity Council (FEC), The Capital Market, and M-NCPPC, Department of Recreation, Prince George’s County.

This event is held at 601 Watkins Park Drive

For more info, visit https://www.ecoffshoots.org/urban-farm-incubator or email urbanfarmincubator@gmail.com

events.title: Fitness in the Parks - Family Zumba
events.description: Dance your way into fitness with a family Zumba® class! This class brings together all members of your family for fun and easy-to-follow dance moves to upbeat music.

events.title: Stretching and Toning with Betty
events.description: Want to remain limber but don’t know where to start? Stretch, flex, and tone with the use of resistance bands, tubing, and calisthenics! Develop muscle elasticity and joint mobility. Begin to relieve pain and improve balance and awareness as you move toward better health.

events.title: Brush Pen & Chill Studio: Halloween Edition
events.description:
Enjoy a creative and relaxing “Snack-and-Paint”-style workshop using our easy-to-use brush pens! Instructors will lead participants in a step-by-step fashion to create bold and beautiful artworks that express their artistic flair. Costumes encouraged! Perfect for ages six & up.

Location:

Creative Suitland Arts Center 
4719 Silver Hill Rd., Suitland 20746

events.title: Latin Dance: Adults
events.description: Adult Latin dance is an energetic, rhythmic, and expressive partner or solo activity focusing on fluid body movement, hip action, and musicality. This social workout activity features popular styles like salsa, bachata, cha-cha, and samba.

events.title: A Spooky Good Time
events.description: Come dressed in your best costume for this annual Halloween event! Bring your candy bags for a fun night of trick-or-treating. Activities will also include a costume contest, candy, games, pumpkins, a haunted hayride, and a haunted house!

events.title: Trunk or Treat Family Halloween Night
events.description: Come celebrate Halloween with us in a safe environment with family and friends! Participate in a car decorating for a chance to win a prize! Wear your favorite costume and join the fun.
